 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The Texas State Bobcats and Fresno State Bulldogs meet for the first time ever on Saturday afternoon in San Marcos with a Pac-12 championship berth on the line. Texas State enters the game off their first road win of the season, beating Oregon State 42-21 last week.
 Texas State Bobcats wide receiver Zechariah Sample (3) catches the ball in the end-zone to score a touchdown on the Bobcats' first drive in the first quarter against the Fresno State Bulldogs at UFCU Stadium in San Marcos, Nov. 14, 2026. (Sara Diggins/Austin American-Statesman)
